units: <cite ref="Taanit 6b:16">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>על כל ט׳ וט׳ וכ׳</he> for every drop of rain which thou hast caused to come down for us.
<cite ref="Keritot 13a:45">Kerith. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ מלוכלכת וכ׳</he> the drop mixing with the moisture of the nibble.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 20b:7">Ab. Zar. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>וט׳ של מרה וכ׳</he> and a drop of poison hangs on it (the sword of the angel of death); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:3:5">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>כט׳ של זבוב</he> like the dripping of a fly (v. infra).—Pl. <he>טִיפִּין</he>, <he>טִיפּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="I00686"><he>טִפּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:8">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>מה מים יורדין ט׳ ט׳ וכ׳</he> as waters come down in drops and form rivers …, so does learning &c. Y. Nidd. l. c.; Bab.
ib. 25ᵃ כשתי ט׳ like two drippings of a fly (Rashi: like the two eye-balls).
<cite ref="Horayot 10a:20">Hor. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה טפות וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>טפין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) how many drops there are in the sea; a. fr.
